title: BeWise: Daily Wisdom Quotes
shortDescription: One beautiful quote every morning. 9 themes, any language, no account, no ads.
fullDescription:
BeWise brings you one beautiful quote every morning, set on a full-screen photograph. Take ten seconds, read it, and carry one good thought through your day.

• A new quote every day, from more than 1,100 hand-picked quotes
• 9 themes: Inspiration, Leadership, Life, Love, Humour, Art, Sports, Students and Programming
• In your language: BeWise follows your phone and translates every quote
• Share any quote as a ready-to-post image card
• A gentle daily reminder at the time you choose
• Browse every past quote in the archive
• A home screen widget with today’s quote and photo
• Free. No account. No ads. No tracking.

BeWise is open source and built with Capacitor by the Capgo team.
